author: Claude Code
content: Verified by loop (attempt 1). .server.test.ts and src/lib/limits.server.test.ts (22 tests, Supabase mocked, source untouched). They cover zero amounts, min_commission, round2, exact and over-limit boundaries, failed rows ignored, and per-kind caps. The files contain no Math.floor payout. HOW TO VERIFY: `npx vitest run` passes 71 tests. `npm run typecheck` and eslint on both files are clean. I ran vitest directly because `npm test` needed approval. RISKS: One test pins existing behaviour where the invest monthly cap reuses monthly_deposit_max. That may be a bug for a human to review.
